<h1>Velocity Arp</h1>

## Purpose

Modulate each row's **velocity** with a short cyclic pattern (up to 8
values, independent length per row), instead of a fixed per-step value.

## Interaction

Two-stage editor. **LHS LP**: overview of all 8 rows' arp patterns (lit =
active step, position colour = playing step, dark = beyond arp length),
and the row/length selector. **RHS LP**: value editor for the selected row
(column = arp step 1–8, row = value 1–8). Each RHS column shows one lit pad
at the stored value's height, not a filled bar; steps past the length keep
showing their value in slate.

## Shortcuts

### LHS: overview side

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row R, col N | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Select row R; a double-tap within 350 ms sets its length to N slots | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> none |
| SHIFT + press row R, col N | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Select row R and set its length to N slots immediately | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift |
| Press row R, col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Select row R without changing its length | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R, col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Reset**: fill the pressed row's arp with `6`, the velocity identity (×1.0) | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Randomise**: selected arp fully random across values 1–8 | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+solo |

### RHS: value editor

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> RHS LP | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Write the pressed row's value into the selected row's arp step (column 1–8) | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> none |
| SHIFT + press column N | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> RHS LP | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Write the value **and** set the selected row's length to N slots (this can shrink the length) | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> RHS LP | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Reset**: fill selected arp with row R's value | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press row R | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> RHS LP | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Randomise**: selected arp gaussian around row R | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+solo |

A stored length of 0 means one active slot, not disabled playback. Column 1
therefore parks the row on its first velocity value. There is no off state
for a velocity arp: after a reset that first slot holds ×1.0, which is why it
behaves as "no arp".
